messages:
Maya: quick check — equinox9b weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/equinox9b/v1/ (size 27.4G). Can ppl confirm checksum and tokenizer we're using?
Kevin: I pulled the weights, md5 matches 8fa3b9d2f1c4e7a9. Repo mentions tokenizer_v2, but there's a tokenizer manifest mismatch in downstream loaders. Anyone seen that?
Felix: Tokenizer_v2 has the unk/pad indices shift we talked about last month. pad_id moved from 0 -> 1 for some releases. I'll run a vocab-check against the checkpoint.
Olga: FYI config.yaml I'm trying to validate:
```
model:
  name: equinox9b
  path: s3://redwood-models/equinox9b/v1/
  tokenizer: tokenizer_v2
serving:
  max_seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache: true
  batch: {min:1, max:32}
```
Samir: For benchmarking, propose this command for smoke/throughput runs:
`./bench --model s3://redwood-models/equinox9b/v1/ --batch-size 8 --seq 1024 --iters 200 --warmup 50`
Maya: Can we target p99 < 120ms for batch 1 and throughput >= 120 tps for batch 8 on our g5.48x? Those are the SLIs product expects.
Kevin: Running smoke now on g5.48x. Will paste numbers when done (~15m).
deploy-bot: perf-smoke (equinox9b) completed. results: latencies (p50/p95/p99) = 54ms / 97ms / 142ms; throughput batch8 = 109 tps. logs: https://ci.redwood/exec/2345
Felix: p99 slightly above target. Suspect tokenizer overhead + KV-cache cold misses on first requests. Try enabling prefix cache warmup and re-run.
Olga: small config tweak suggestion: set serving.batch.max = 16 and enable prefix_cache.warmup = true in the runtime config. Also validate tokenizer.json mapping for pad/unk.
Samir: I'll schedule 3 runs (batch1, batch4, batch8) with warmup enabled and collect p50/p95/p99 + cpu/gpu utilization. tagging @Kevin @Felix for review.
Maya: thanks. If p99 still >120ms we'll try fallback to quantized weights (4-bit) and measure delta on throughput/quality. Keep notes on any tokenization diffs.
Kevin: noted. Opening PR for config changes + attaching the perf logs: https://github.com/redwood/equinox/pull/112
Maya: great — leaving this thread open for async updates. :thumbsup:
